competitors.name: Petpooja
competitors.pricing_trap: ₹15,000+ upfront license fee + ₹3,000 yearly renewal fee
weaknesses: Heavy capital outlay before printing first bill
Charges extra for QR code standees and loyalty add-ons
competitors.cafe_qr_wedge: ₹99/Month Sachet Micro-Pricing with zero upfront lock-in and free acrylic standee kit.

competitors.name: Swiggy & Zomato
competitors.pricing_trap: 25% to 30% top-line commission on every food order + customer platform fee hikes
weaknesses: Aggregators own 100% of the customer phone numbers and data
Advertises competitor restaurants on the merchant's listing
Delayed weekly payouts hurting cafe cash flow
Customer fee hikes make dine-in food seem overpriced
competitors.cafe_qr_wedge: 0% Commission Direct Online Delivery & Table QR. You keep 100% of the bill and own the diner database.

competitors.name: DotPe
competitors.pricing_trap: Transaction percentage cuts (1-2%) + complex multi-outlet enterprise setup
weaknesses: Too bloated and slow for small standalone cafes and bakeries
Slow thermal receipt print speed on local kitchen printers
competitors.cafe_qr_wedge: 0.8-second ultra-lightweight ESC/POS thermal printing with dynamic UPI on receipt.

competitors.name: POSist / Restroworks
competitors.pricing_trap: Expensive enterprise SaaS ($50+/month) with strict multi-chain contracts
weaknesses: Completely unaffordable for standalone cafes, food trucks, and chai stalls
Steep learning curve requiring staff training
competitors.cafe_qr_wedge: Zero-training touch billing board and mobile-first self ordering.
